mechanism.network: Joker Flip / Great Blue progressive network
mechanism.jackpotGame: 12-card collection; collect three matching-suit cards, with automatic resolution if the timer expires
mechanism.rtpWording: The Spanish rules state RTP 95.45% and a 1.98% jackpot contribution; progressive prizes are excluded from the RTP calculation wording. Do not reinterpret this as a complete state-dependent current RTP without exact hazard and tier allocation.

pafSpain.interpretation: Same displayed amount across multiple Joker Flip-family games is evidence of a shared network headline, not proof of which tier it represents.

speedybetSpain.interpretation: Same displayed amount across multiple games is compatible with a shared progressive network but does not bind the headline to KING/JOKER/QUEEN/JACK.
